data.evidence: There has been a reassessment of the net provision for claims outstanding held at the previous year end. The release in 2021 amounted to $57.0m (2020: $42.8m), attributable to the following classes of business: Marine 22.5, Political Risk 3.0, Political Violence and War 22.8, Property 20.7, Specialty (26.1), Treaty 14.1, Total 57.0
